dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mind telling me about your dog?

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Ah. Baguette is an earnest girl who's dedicated to her work. I'm most fond of her.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: She's got a truly keen sense of smell, and she can sniff out all manner of contraband and prohibited items.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: No human inspector can beat her in that regard, but...

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: Baguette is tireless at work, and just as tireless when it comes to tearing the house down.

dialogues.speaker: Etienne
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only she could be this at peace at home.
